text:
Ravi: Quick thread to finalize the benchmark narrative + landing assets for next Wed webinar. Focus: latency vs cost tradeoffs, concrete routing, and two call-to-actions for trial flow.
Sasha: Suggest visual flow: left panel = hero metric (cost per 1k tokens), middle = latency curves (median + 95th), right = routing map (Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private). clean iconography.
Eli: Data anchor: our canonical workload sample (N=5k requests): median prompt len=320, mean=600, p95=3.2k. sharing bench csv in a sec. note:hosted uses burst pools, dedicated shows steadier throughput.
Ravi: Good callouts. We need one soundbite for social: short, punchy. Ideas?
Jordan: "Make inference predictable: lower unit costs, honest latency SLAs." short enough. Could A/B with: "Pay for predictability, not surprises."
Sasha: I like both. For hero copy maybe Jordan's first, subhead with the second.
Priya: On the routing side, we need specific lead qualifiers so Sales can act. Proposed form questions: 1) "Primary priority: cost | strict latency | compliance" 2) "Monthly token volume" 3) "Do you need private network deployment? (Y/N)" Map answers to tags.
Ravi: Add one more freeform: "Describe your most latency-sensitive use case" so we can spot edge cases.
Eli: bench-bot posted results: https://internal/bench/2142. Key numbers to call out in slide footer: Hosted median=85ms, p95=345ms; Dedicated median=120ms, p95=190ms; Quantized median=95ms, p95=210ms. Also cost-per-1k: Hosted=$0.45, Dedicated=$0.28, Quantized=$0.22 (approx).
Jordan: Good. We should surface an explicit tradeoff box: "Why Dedicated median > Hosted sometimes" short explainer: Dedicated has reserved capacity but different autoscale thresholds and slightly higher per-request scheduling that smooths spikes.
Sasha: Visual note: use small multiples for different prompt-length buckets, not single aggregate. That avoids misleading medians.
Priya: Sales routing pseudo rules:
```
if primary_priority == 'latency': tag('low-latency-trial')
if monthly_tokens > 1e9: tag('high_volume_account')
if compliance == 'yes': tag('private-deploy-interest')
if company_size > 1000: assign('enterprise-acct-team') else assign('growth-promo')
```
Ravi: Perfect. Also include a checkbox on form: "I want benchmarking help" to trigger a Perf PO intake.
Eli: One more data nuance we must footnote: batching uplift depends on sequence-length variance + KV cache hit rate. Example: uniform 256-token prompts -> 3.1x cost improvement. mixed lengths -> 1.2x. call it out in the appendix.
Jordan: For webinar CTA variants: 1) "Get a tailored cost forecast" (form capture) 2) "Request a latency POC" (sales handoff). We'll run both and route accordingly.
Sasha: I'll deliver the hero + three-panel mock by EOD today, then full deck Monday. Colors: high contrast for latency curves, muted for cost bars.
Priya: Sales playbook bullets I'll have Monday midday: how to qualify, handle pricing objections, typical ROI examples.
Ravi: I'm drafting landing copy now. rough hero: "Predictable inference economics for real products." subhead: "See measured latency, unit cost, and routing strategies so you can pick the right deployment." Posting first draft in ~2h.
bench-bot: new run queued for quant configs, ETA 45m.
Eli: once bench-bot returns I'll update the footer numbers. keep the draft assets flexible to swap numbers.
Jordan: I'll prepare two variant registration flows in the growth experiment dashboard.
Sasha: timeline ack: comps today, first deck Monday, rehearsals Tue morning. everyone good?
Ravi: Yep. thanks all — will consolidate this into a short brief after the bench run updates. :rocket:
